buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic

Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Cmo Nagar Panchayat Basna payable at 74000 . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must submit a registration certificate under category "D" in the integrated registration syste m of the public works department, Chhattisgarh. 2. If it is a partnership firm, the registration certificate and partnership deed must be attached. 3. PAN Card. 4. GST Registration. 5. EPF Registration. 6. ESIC Registration. 7. Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last two years. 8. Experience Certificate of similar nature of work. 9.Tornover Certificate certified by CA with UDIN Number. 10. Bank Solvency Certificate equal to or more than 15% of the tender estimate amount not older than 12 months. 11. Affidavit of Not Benig Blacklisted Rs. 100 non-judicial stamp paper, original affidavit declaring thet the bidder is not blacklisted by any department/institution. Submission Instructions Online Submission (before bid end date): All documents from point (1) to (11) must be notarized copies and submitted online. Physical Submission (must reach before bid closing date): Along with online submission, the original copies of affidavit and earnest money deposit must be sent phys ically by speed post to the concerned authority. . 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support

Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
